comparison.objective: Identify and close only open push-latch cabinet doors; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Visual state discrimination and simple pushing versus fine tool insertion, counterholding, rotation, torque control, and response-guided iteration.
comparison.success_condition: All initially open doors latched without popping a closed one; no physical tuning or dynamic-response measurements.
comparison.reason: This tests state recognition and selective actuation, not dexterous adjustment or energy absorption.
